topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I just moved in, and already, I find myself surrounded by someone else's secrets. A hidden room, tucked away behind a wall in what I thought was just a cozy little study. I should be thrilled, right? After all, it's like finding a bonus feature in a poorly constructed box. But all I can think about is the previous owner's smug smile, the one they probably wore every time they thought about their little hideaway. Screw them and their clandestine corners. I didn’t buy a crypt; I bought a home. Now, I’m stuck trying to figure out what to do with this damn room, and it’s already taken up more of my time and energy than it deserves.
